title: Build the next native design version
outcome: Allocate WellSpent 0.2.0 (5) and build an exact-source signed archive of the redesigned iPhone and Watch apps.

included: Allocate marketing version 0.2.0 and build 5 across all four components.
Freeze the exact source commit and build a signed Release archive with current automatic signing.
Independently inspect source identity, signatures, entitlements, privacy manifests and dSYM coverage.
Document how to test idle, paused and running Watch complication entry.
Record coordinator-managed verification receipts, integration result and release-task state.
excluded: App Store Connect upload, App Review submission and public release.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A clean frozen source receipt identifies version 0.2.0 (5), with generated-project parity and no functional changes after the validated design candidate.
The exact-source signed Release archive contains valid iPhone, iPhone widget, Watch app and Watch widget components with matching versions, signatures and dSYMs.
